editorial:
If you love Shrek and want something festive, this short holiday special is a fun little treat. Shrek promises Fiona and the kids a perfect Christmas, but he has no idea what that actually means. So he grabs a book and tries to learn everything about the holiday in one night. Just when he thinks he has it all figured out, Donkey, Puss in Boots, Gingy, and the rest of the gang show up uninvited and turn his quiet family night into total chaos. The vibe is silly, warm, and very Shrek, with plenty of jokes for both kids and adults.

The animation still looks great, and the voice cast brings the same energy you expect from the movies. The pacing is quick since it is only about half an hour, so it never drags. On the downside, it can feel a bit rushed, and some jokes are recycled from the films. Still, it is a sweet story about learning that Christmas is really about being together, not getting everything perfect. Families with young kids will enjoy it most. You can stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for your collection.
endingExplained: After the guests ruin his plans, Shrek gets frustrated and sends everyone away. But when he sees how sad Fiona and the kids are, he realizes he was wrong. He invites everyone back, and each character shares their own Christmas story. The night ends with Shrek reading a special book to his family and friends, showing that the best Christmas is simply spending time with the people you love.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves family-friendly holiday movies and the Shrek universe.
